items.note: Agent states screens and gates do not limit to 18+ mgd and omits relocation, opposite the engineers' velocity limit above 16.5 mgd.
Agent matches 14-15 mgd firm capacity but proposes rehabilitating and testing Pump 3 rather than replacing Pump 1 with a 6 mgd VFD pump.
Agent identifies the 12 mgd single-basin limit and recommends a second parallel basin.
Agent recommends two additional filters and upsizing filter-to-waste from about 2 mgd to 3-4 mgd per filter.
Agent finds only 57 minutes at 18 mgd and proposes VFD level control plus 85k gal, rather than concluding no change is needed.
Agent matches the approximately 11.5 mgd true firm capacity and recommends adding 4 mgd and 6 mgd pumps to reach 18 mgd firm.
Agent matches the 14 mgd surge protection limit and recommends replacing it with a larger tank for 18 mgd.
